📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

6. Speculative Appetite?

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strength is concentrated in oil: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +12.25%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +17.47%). Natural gas is under pressure: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -14.11%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed strength: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +3.39%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +12.25%). Divergence: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -5.07%) while SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -0.78%); this is mixed evidence, not a broad equity trend confirmation.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective in the NEUTRAL regime: energy and defensive sectors show relative strength, while growth leadership is unconfirmed. Monitor the bond-equity split—TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +3.39%) against SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -0.78%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If broad breadth holds at 7/11 or higher, monitor energy strength in XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +12.25%).  
BEARISH: If tech momentum weakens again, reduce exposure to XLK, currently RECOVERY (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -5.07%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If oil momentum persists, monitor BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +17.47%).  
BEARISH: If weakness broadens, watch CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -3.00%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -14.11%).

13. Key Levels?
The feed does not provide price levels; use directional thresholds instead: breadth below 7/11 would erode the current broad-strength signal; VXX turning negative on the week would ease the fear signal; SPY/TLT turning positive would indicate stocks improving versus bonds.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and broad strength offset by mixed cross-asset signals. Energy and defensives are showing relative strength, while style leadership remains mixed. Monitor rising volatility and bonds outperforming equities for signs that breadth is beginning to weaken.
